overview:
This 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari is a private road trip from Entebbe: 1 night in Kampala, 2 nights at Paraa Safari Lodge in Murchison Falls National Park and 2 nights at Kyaninga Safari Lodge for chimpanzee trekking in Kibale. Rhino tracking at Ziwa and a Nile boat cruise are on the way. The price starts from USD 2,908 per adult, and it suits first-time visitors to Uganda.

It combines Uganda's two biggest wildlife draws, big game on the Nile savannah and habituated chimpanzees in the forest, travelling in an extended Land Cruiser with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking driver guide, on full board.

Why choose a 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari?

The 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari packs savannah, river and rainforest into under a week. Murchison Falls is where the Nile forces itself through a narrow gorge, and its northern plains hold elephants, Rothschild's giraffes, buffaloes, Uganda kobs and lions. Kibale National Park is Uganda's best-known chimpanzee trekking forest.

The route also takes in Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary, the only place in Uganda to track white rhinos on foot, and Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary, a community-run swamp walk known for birds and monkeys.

  • Primate lovers: a chimpanzee trek in Kibale with one hour beside the group.
  • Big game fans: a morning game drive and a Nile cruise in Murchison Falls.
  • Short-break travellers: rhinos, the falls and chimpanzees in six days.

What to expect on the 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari

Day 1 starts at Entebbe International Airport with a transfer to Kampala Serena Hotel, about 45-60 minutes away, and a welcome dinner. On day 2 you leave at about 7:00 am for Murchison Falls, a drive of about 4-6 hours, stopping to track white rhinos on foot at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary and for lunch in Masindi. You end the day at the top of the falls before checking in to Paraa Safari Lodge.

Day 3 is a morning game drive on the Murchison savannah and an afternoon boat cruise on the Nile to the base of the falls, with hippos, Nile crocodiles and fish eagles. Day 4 is a drive of about 5-6 hours south to Kibale and Kyaninga Safari Lodge.

Day 5 is the chimpanzee trek: a briefing at park headquarters, 2-4 hours in the forest and one hour with the chimpanzees, then an afternoon walk at Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary. On day 6 you drive about 5-6 hours back to Kampala and Entebbe, with craft-market stops, for your flight or hotel.

How fit do you need to be for chimpanzee trekking in Kibale?

Chimpanzee trekking in Kibale needs average fitness. On this safari the trek takes 2-4 hours on forest trails, depending on how far the chimpanzees have moved, and the time with them is limited to one hour. Wear long trousers and closed walking shoes. Read our chimpanzee trekking in Kibale guide for permits, rules and what to pack.

What is included in this Uganda chimpanzee and wildlife safari?

The price includes a pop-up roof extended Land Cruiser, an English-speaking driver guide, fuel and all ground transport, full-board accommodation, en-route lunches, drinking water in the vehicle, unlimited game drives, park entrance fees for clients, vehicle and guide, a ranger on game drives, the afternoon Nile boat cruise, all taxes and airport transfers. Lodges can be chosen at luxury, mid-range or budget level.

Not included are visas, passports, domestic and international flights, beers and wines, and personal items. faq.a: The 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari runs all year. The drier months, usually June to September and December to February, are the easiest for forest trails in Kibale and for game drives in Murchison Falls. The page does not set best months, so ask us about your dates.

faq.q: Is the 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes, families can join the 6 day chimpanzee trekking and Murchison Falls safari, but the Kibale chimpanzee trek has a minimum age set by the Uganda Wildlife Authority, usually 12 years. Younger children can enjoy the game drive, the Nile cruise and Bigodi. Drives of 4-6 hours link the parks, so tell us your children's ages.
